tasks.title: LEAF D2 detonation_semantic_gate — additive Semantic-Oracle verdict over injected runner result
acceptance_criteria: ngv2/detonation.py gains a NEW top-level helper semantic_verdict(exit_code, stdout, stderr, fs_snapshot_diff, *, success_marker, expected_fs_signature) -> str.
Returns 'confirmed' ONLY when exit_code==0 AND success_marker is in (stdout OR stderr) AND expected_fs_signature is a substring of fs_snapshot_diff.
Returns 'error' when exit_code is nonzero (nonzero dominates all other conditions).
Returns 'refuted' when exit_code is in (0, None) but the confirmed bar is not met.

The existing DetonationChamber symbol is preserved byte-for-byte; the patch is emitted as a single __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ with EXACTLY ONE entry of kind 'symbol', name 'DetonationChamber', whose code reproduces DetonationChamber verbatim then appends the new semantic_verdict def.
make_mock_runner and make_scripted_runner remain importable from ngv2.poc_runner unchanged and are NOT moved, redefined, or re-emitted in detonation.py.

spec.objective: Additively extend ngv2/detonation.py with a pure Semantic-Oracle verdict helper that upgrades the weak exit-code+grep gate: given an injected runner result (exit_code, stdout, stderr, fs_snapshot_diff) plus success_marker and expected_fs_signature, return 'confirmed' only on exit0+marker+FS mutation, else 'error' or 'refuted'. DetonationChamber stays unchanged; the poc_runner injected-runner seam is consumed as-is.
functional_requirements: Add a NEW top-level def semantic_verdict(exit_code, stdout, stderr, fs_snapshot_diff, *, success_marker, expected_fs_signature) -> str; pure, no I/O, no time, no random.
Return 'confirmed' ONLY when exit_code==0 AND success_marker in (stdout OR stderr) AND expected_fs_signature is a substring of fs_snapshot_diff.
Return 'error' whenever exit_code is nonzero (this dominates marker and FS-signature presence).
Return 'refuted' when exit_code in (0, None) but the confirmed bar is not met.

Emit a single __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ with EXACTLY ONE 'symbol' entry named 'DetonationChamber' that reproduces DetonationChamber byte-for-byte (including its module-top 'from ngv2.contracts import ...') then appends semantic_verdict; do not emit whole-file and do not alter DetonationChamber logic.
Keep make_mock_runner/make_scripted_runner importable from ngv2.poc_runner unchanged; consume them as the injected-runner seam without moving, redefining, or re-emitting them.
spec.interfaces: semantic_verdict(exit_code: int|None, stdout: str, stderr: str, fs_snapshot_diff: str, *, success_marker: str, expected_fs_signature: str) -> str returning one of 'confirmed' | 'error' | 'refuted'. Consumes injected runner results shaped by ngv2.poc_runner.RUNNER_RESULT_FIELDS = ('exit_code','stdout','stderr','duration_ms') via make_mock_runner/make_scripted_runner.
edge_cases: exit_code nonzero while success_marker present in stdout AND expected_fs_signature present in fs_snapshot_diff: nonzero dominates, verdict is 'error' (not 'confirmed').
exit_code==0 with success_marker present but expected_fs_signature absent from fs_snapshot_diff: verdict is 'refuted'.
exit_code is None: verdict is 'refuted' (None is in the (0, None) refuted band, never 'error').
exit_code==0 with success_marker present only in stderr (not stdout) and expected_fs_signature present: verdict is 'confirmed'.
spec.non_goals: No integration with any live runner; no real bwrap/subprocess/shutil.copytree/pip/network code; no process spawn or socket; no HardenedSandboxRunner; no faketime; no whole-repo copytree. Does not modify, move, or re-emit DetonationChamber, make_mock_runner, or make_scripted_runner; does not emit a whole-file patch.
spec.implementation_notes:
Patch is additive ONLY. Emit one __JANUSMASK_PATCHES__ entry, kind 'symbol', name 'DetonationChamber' (the R-ANCHOR and only top-level symbol). In 'code', copy DetonationChamber byte-for-byte exactly as staged read-only at /home/xnihil0zer0/JanusMaskJR_agentwork/claude/claude-r1-notask-7f00feae/inbox/targets/ngv2/detonation.py (~26 lines; change nothing, the 'from ngv2.contracts import ...' stays at module top), then append the new top-level def semantic_verdict. Logic: if exit_code != 0 and exit_code is not None -> return 'error'; if exit_code == 0 and success_marker in stdout or success_marker in stderr, and expected_fs_signature in fs_snapshot_diff -> return 'confirmed'; otherwise (exit_code in (0, None)) -> return 'refuted'. Consume make_mock_runner/make_scripted_runner from poc_runner unchanged in tests.

# CREDENTIAL-NAMING CONSTRAINT (the AST security gate FAILS the build if a variable whose name contains (case-insensitive) "password", "secret", or "key" is assigned a string literal -- it reads as a hardcoded credential even though this is an external clean-room target with no real secret). NEVER bind a string literal to such a variable. Use a neutral name instead (field_name, check_id, label, name, ident, column) or iterate a collection literal / build the mapping from a list of tuples. This applies to dict keys held in a temp var, field labels, and constant identifiers.

# STDLIB-ONLY CONSTRAINT (the verification environment installs NO third-party packages, so importing one fails collection -> the whole build is rolled back and the leaf is parked). Import ONLY the Python standard library. Import NO third-party package: NO pydantic, NO pydantic_settings, NO attrs, NO pyyaml, NO numpy, NO requests, etc. For data models / config use stdlib dataclasses (dataclasses.dataclass), enum.Enum, typing, and plain dict / json instead of pydantic BaseModel / BaseSettings. If the spec mentions pydantic-style validation, re-express it with stdlib dataclasses + manual checks.

# DETERMINISM CONSTRAINT (the AST nondeterminism gate FAILS the build if it sees a wall-clock or nondeterministic source). Do NOT call datetime.now / datetime.utcnow, time.time / time.monotonic, unseeded random, uuid, os.urandom, or secrets to obtain a timestamp / id / randomness. Instead accept any timestamp, seed, or clock as an EXPLICIT parameter with a deterministic default (the oracle injects it, e.g. via now_fn / make_scripted_clock), so the same inputs always produce the same output.
spec.implementation_notes_anchor: DetonationChamber is the only top-level symbol in detonation.py; preserve it exactly.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Injected runner result tuples built via poc_runner.make_mock_runner/make_scripted_runner and literal tuples: (exit0, marker-in-stdout, fs-with-signature); (exit1, marker+fs both present); (exit0, marker, fs-without-signature); (exitNone, ...); (exit0, marker-in-stderr-only, fs-with-signature). A read-only copy of the staged DetonationChamber source for the byte-for-byte preservation assertion. No time/random.

token_budget_ratio.note: Tiny additive helper but the oracle pins the full truth table plus DetonationChamber preservation and poc_runner importability, so tests dominate.

tasks.title: LEAF D1 feedback_synth — pure telemetry-to-diagnostic prompt formatter
acceptance_criteria: ngv2/feedback_synth.py is a NEW whole-file module exposing build_diagnostic_prompt(prev_poc, telemetry) -> str.
The function is pure and deterministic: no I/O, no time, no random; calling it twice with identical inputs returns byte-identical output.
Telemetry dict keys consulted are exit_code (int|None), stdout (str), stderr (str), marker_present (bool), all optional with safe defaults when absent.
Failure is classified into exactly one of ENV_PATH_ERROR / SYNTAX_API_ERROR / PAYLOAD_REFUTED with precedence ENV>SYNTAX>REFUTED, and the chosen class token appears verbatim in the emitted markdown.

ENV_PATH_ERROR is derived from import_error/network_error signatures (e.g. ModuleNotFoundError, 'connection refused') reusing ngv2.crash_analyzer.ERROR_PATTERNS and ngv2.trace_parser.infer_failure_mode as inputs (the three class names are NOT assumed to pre-exist in ERROR_PATTERNS).
SYNTAX_API_ERROR is derived from SyntaxError or API-misuse TypeError/AttributeError tracebacks; PAYLOAD_REFUTED requires a clean run (exit_code==0, no env/syntax signature, marker_present false).
Each of stdout and stderr is truncated to keep at most the first 250 plus the last 750 lines, prioritizing tracebacks, and deprecation noise is regex-stripped.
The emitted diagnostic markdown references prev_poc via its finding_id.

spec.objective: Build ngv2/feedback_synth.py: a pure, deterministic string transform that turns a previous PoC plus a detonation telemetry tuple into a structured diagnostic markdown prompt, classifying the failure into ENV_PATH_ERROR/SYNTAX_API_ERROR/PAYLOAD_REFUTED and bounding stream size, with zero I/O and zero nondeterminism.
functional_requirements: Expose build_diagnostic_prompt(prev_poc, telemetry) -> str as the sole public entry point; pure, no I/O, no time, no random.
Consult telemetry dict keys exit_code(int|None), stdout(str), stderr(str), marker_present(bool), all optional with deterministic defaults when missing.
Truncate EACH of stdout and stderr to at most first 250 + last 750 lines, prioritizing tracebacks, and regex-strip deprecation noise.

Classify ENV_PATH_ERROR from import_error/network_error signatures (ModuleNotFoundError, 'connection refused') by reusing ngv2.crash_analyzer.ERROR_PATTERNS and ngv2.trace_parser.infer_failure_mode as inputs; do not assume the class names pre-exist in ERROR_PATTERNS.

Classify SYNTAX_API_ERROR from SyntaxError or API-misuse TypeError/AttributeError tracebacks, and PAYLOAD_REFUTED from a clean run (exit_code==0, no env/syntax signature, marker_present false); apply precedence ENV>SYNTAX>REFUTED and emit the chosen class token verbatim.
Emit structured diagnostic markdown that references prev_poc via its finding_id and is deterministic (calling twice yields equal output).
spec.interfaces: build_diagnostic_prompt(prev_poc, telemetry: dict) -> str. prev_poc carries a finding_id attribute/key. telemetry keys: exit_code(int|None), stdout(str), stderr(str), marker_present(bool), all optional. Reads ngv2.crash_analyzer.ERROR_PATTERNS (Dict[str, List[str]]) and ngv2.trace_parser.infer_failure_mode(entry)->Optional[str] as classification building blocks.
edge_cases: Telemetry carries BOTH an import_error signature (ModuleNotFoundError) and a SyntaxError traceback: precedence ENV>SYNTAX must yield ENV_PATH_ERROR, with the ENV_PATH_ERROR token verbatim in the output.
stdout has more than 1000 lines: output keeps only the first 250 plus the last 750 lines of that stream (truncation bound exact), and the same bound applies independently to stderr.
exit_code==0 with marker_present false and no env/syntax signature classifies as PAYLOAD_REFUTED.
All optional telemetry keys absent: function still returns deterministic markdown referencing prev_poc.finding_id without raising.
spec.non_goals: No integration with any live runner; no real bwrap/subprocess/shutil.copytree/pip/network code; no module that spawns a process or opens a socket; no faketime/determinism shim; no I/O of any kind; no time or random. Does not modify ERROR_PATTERNS, infer_failure_mode, detonation.py, or poc_runner.py.
spec.implementation_notes:
Define the three class tokens as module constants in feedback_synth.py (they are NOT in ERROR_PATTERNS). Map crash_analyzer.ERROR_PATTERNS keys import_error/network_error -> ENV_PATH_ERROR. Use infer_failure_mode as a secondary label input. Truncation: split each stream on lines, if len > 1000 keep lines[:250] + a marker + lines[-750:]; surface traceback lines preferentially. Strip deprecation noise via a compiled regex. Build markdown deterministically with a stable section order and the verbatim class token; reference prev_poc.finding_id.

This applies to dict keys held in a temp var, field labels, and constant identifiers.

# STDLIB-ONLY CONSTRAINT (the verification environment installs NO third-party packages, so importing one fails collection -> the whole build is rolled back and the leaf is parked). Import ONLY the Python standard library. Import NO third-party package: NO pydantic, NO pydantic_settings, NO attrs, NO pyyaml, NO numpy, NO requests, etc. For data models / config use stdlib dataclasses (dataclasses.dataclass), enum.Enum, typing, and plain dict / json instead of pydantic BaseModel / BaseSettings. If the spec mentions pydantic-style validation, re-express it with stdlib dataclasses + manual checks.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Fixed telemetry tuples per class: (a) stdout/stderr containing ModuleNotFoundError and 'connection refused'; (b) a SyntaxError and an AttributeError traceback; (c) exit_code==0 + marker_present false clean run; (d) a >1000-line stdout and a >1000-line stderr; (e) a telemetry dict with both import and syntax signatures for precedence; (f) an empty telemetry dict. A stub prev_poc exposing finding_id. All literal, no time/random.
